<js>
try{
var cfg = SRCFG(source);
var modes = ['小说','听书','漫画','短剧'];
var tab = cfg.mode || '小说';
if(modes.indexOf(tab) < 0){ tab = '小说'; }
var srcList = {};
try{ srcList = JSON.parse(String(java.ajax(host + '/legado/sources'))); }catch(e){}
var plats = SRCLIST(srcList, tab);
var out = [];
out.push(SRFLT('模式', modes, tab, '模式', 1));
out.push(SRFLT('平台', plats, cfg.platform, '平台', 1));
if(tab == '小说'){
  out.push(SRFLT('频道', ['男频','女频'], cfg.gender, '频道', 1));
}
var plat = (cfg.platform=='' || cfg.platform=='全部' || plats.indexOf(cfg.platform)<0) ? '番茄' : PLATNAME(cfg.platform);
var gd = (cfg.gender == '女频') ? 2 : 1;
var menuUrl = host + '/legado/explore/menu?tab=' + encodeURIComponent(tab) + '&source=' + encodeURIComponent(plat) + '&gender=' + encodeURIComponent(cfg.gender);
var menuLoaded = false;
try{
  var menu = JSON.parse(String(java.ajax(menuUrl)));
  if(Array.isArray(menu) && menu.length > 0){
    out = out.concat(menu);
    menuLoaded = true;
    try{
      var sv = {};
      try{ sv = JSON.parse(source.getVariable() || '{}'); }catch(e){}
      sv._exploreCache = JSON.stringify(menu);
      source.setVariable(JSON.stringify(sv));
    }catch(e){}
  }
}catch(e){}
if(!menuLoaded){
  var cached = '';
  try{
    var sv = JSON.parse(source.getVariable() || '{}');
    cached = sv._exploreCache || '';
  }catch(e){}
  if(cached){
    try{
      var cm = JSON.parse(cached);
      if(Array.isArray(cm) && cm.length > 0){
        out = out.concat(cm);
        menuLoaded = true;
      }
    }catch(e){}
  }
}
if(!menuLoaded){
  var bt = encodeURIComponent(tab);
  var bp = encodeURIComponent(plat);
  var ranks = ['推荐榜','完本榜','热门榜','新书榜'];
  for(var ri=0; ri<ranks.length; ri++){
    out.push({title:ranks[ri], url:host+'/legado/explore/data?source='+bp+'&tab='+bt+'&bdtype='+encodeURIComponent(ranks[ri])+'&gender='+gd+'&is_ranking=1&page={{page}}', style:{layout_flexGrow:1, layout_flexBasisPercent:0.25}});
  }
}
JSON.stringify(out);
}catch(e){
  JSON.stringify([{title:'发现页加载失败，下拉刷新重试', url:'', style:{layout_flexGrow:1, layout_flexBasisPercent:1}}]);
}
</js>
